blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count.
We instead study fixed-vocabulary
image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed
for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a
complete category–count vector without being told which categories
appear.
We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware
structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic
segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from
neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot
determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM 2.1 generates masks,
while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features.
A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance
affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph
construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin
admission then convert each admitted component into one count with
replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without
count or density-map targets.
On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80,
with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned
relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU,
CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation–merge trade-off. We
also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual counting is typically formulated as a conditional, single-category task. A model receives an exemplar or a category query that specifies what to count and returns a scalar count or density map for that target ( Ranjan et al. 2021 ; Liu et al. 2022 ; Jiang et al. 2023 ; Amini-Naieni et al. 2024 ) . This interface is effective when the target is known in advance, but it does not directly answer a scene-level question: which object categories are present, and how many instances of each occur? We study image-query-free multi-category counting, where a global vocabulary is fixed once for each deployment or evaluation run, but no image-dependent category selection is provided. Thus, image-query-free does not mean vocabulary-free; rather, the model receives no per-image target category, exemplar, or restricted class list. Given only an RGB image, it returns a complete category–count vector together with the proposal groups supporting its nonzero entries.
blocks.zh: 视觉计数一般被表述为有条件的单类任务. 一个模型收到一个示例或一个类别查询,该查询指定了该目标的计数和返回一个平面计数或密度图(Ranjan等. 2021; 刘等. 2022; Jiang等 2023; Amini-Naieni等 2024 (中文(简体) ). 当目标提前知道时,这个接口是有效的,但它并没有直接回答一个场景级的问题:存在哪些对象类别,以及每个事件发生多少个? 我们研究无图像清空多类计数,其中每次部署或评价运行都会固定一个全局词汇,但没有提供依赖图像的类别选择. 因此,无图像-query-free并不意味着没有词汇;相反,模型没有获得每个图像的目标类别,实例,或者限制性的类列表. 仅考虑到RGB的图像,它与支持其非零条目的提议组一起返回一个完整的类别-计数向量.

blocks.en: Several lines of work provide parts of this capability. Category-labeled detectors can be converted into count vectors by summing detections, supervised multi-class counters predict fixed category channels, and reference-less counters can organize foreground objects into image-specific groups ( Minderer et al. 2023 ; Xu et al. 2021 ; Hobley and Prisacariu 2024 ; Spanakis et al. 2026 ) . What remains underexplored is the instance-consolidation problem that appears when counting is built from generic segmentation proposals without an image-specific target. Automatic segmenters produce over-complete candidate sets containing duplicate masks for one object, partial views of the same object, and visually similar proposals from neighboring objects. Semantic scores can assign category names to proposals, but they do not determine whether two proposals denote the same physical instance. Reliable counting therefore requires resolving proposal identity before selecting one representative and one label for each surviving group.
blocks.zh: 一些工作提供了这种能力的一部分。 分类标签检测器可以通过相声检测被转换为计数向量,被监督的多级计数器预测固定的分类通道,无参考的计数器可以将前方对象组织成图像特定组(Minder等. 2023; 许等. 2021; Hobley and Prisacariu 2024; Spanakis等 2026 (英语). 尚未充分探讨的是一个实例整合问题,它是在根据通用分块建议进行计算时出现的,没有针对特定图像的目标。 自动分页器会生成一个对象的超完整候选套件,包含一个对象的重复口罩,同一对象的部分视图,以及相邻对象的视觉相近建议. 语义分数可以给建议书指定类别名称,但不能确定两个建议书是否表示相同的物理实例. 因此,要进行可靠的计算,就必须在为每个幸存群体选择一名代表和一个标签之前,先解决提案身份问题。

blocks.en: We introduce UniCounting , an instance-aware proposal-consolidation framework built on frozen foundation-model features. SAM 2.1 generates candidate masks, while DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features ( Ravi et al. 2025 ; Oquab et al. 2024 ; Radford et al. 2021 ; Cherti et al. 2023 ) . A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head learns pairwise same-instance affinity from instance-mask-derived supervision. UniCounting converts these affinities into a sparse graph, forms connected components, selects a maximum-category-margin representative for each component, assigns the representative’s fixed-vocabulary label, and applies background-margin admission using a validation-calibrated threshold. The distinction is not the absence of a vocabulary, but whether image-dependent category selection is supplied. Each admitted component contributes one count. The resulting vector is therefore accompanied by an explicit trail from proposals and relation edges to components, representatives, labels, and admission decisions. Only the relation head is trained; the category head and the three foundation-model components remain frozen, and training uses no count or density-map targets. Figure 1 illustrates this proposal-to-group-to-count trace.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了UniCounting, 一个基于被冻结的地基模型特性的、有实例意识的建议整合框架。 SAM 2.1生成候选口罩,而DINOv2和OpenCLIP则提供关系和类别特性(Ravi等. 2025; Oquab等人著. 2024; Radford等2021; Cherti等2023.). 一个3,267个参数的类别共享关系头从实例任务产生的监督中学习对等的同类型亲和性。 UniCouncting将这些相近之处转换为稀疏的图表,形式连接组件,为每个组件选择一个最大类别-边距代表,指定该代表的固定站名标签,并使用一个验证校正阈值应用背景-边距录取. 区别不在于没有词汇,而在于是否提供了依赖图像的类别选择. 每个被接纳的构成部分都贡献一个计数。 因此,由此产生的矢量有一条从提案和关系边缘到组成部分、代表、标签和接纳决定的明确线索。 只有关系头接受训练;类别头和三个基础模型组件仍然被冻结,训练没有使用计数或密度图目标. 图1显示了建议逐组追踪的情况。

blocks.en: We evaluate UniCounting at two complementary levels. At the system level, complete-vector experiments measure category-wise counting, absent-category errors, and presence prediction, including a calibrated category-labeled detector as a direct reference. At the mechanism level, a matched-decoder study holds the candidate pool and downstream decoder fixed while replacing only the edge score; group-partition diagnostics and component-wise ablations then localize the effects of relation scoring, representative selection, labeling, and admission. Our primary evidence comes from the complete-vector COCO evaluation and the matched-decoder analysis, while the remaining held-out and single-coordinate datasets serve as supporting diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个相辅相成的层面评价联合协商。 在系统层面,完整的载体实验可以测量分类计数,缺分类出错,以及存在预测,包括校正分类标签检测器作为直接参考. 在机制层面,匹配解码器研究将候选人池和下游解码器固定下来,同时仅取代边缘分数;分组分数诊断和组件分数分出,然后将关系分数、代表性选择、标签和录取的效果本地化。 我们的主要证据来自完全的COCO评价和相匹配的解码分析,而剩余的被搁置和单坐标数据集则作为辅助诊断.

blocks.en: Our contributions are twofold: • We cast fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting as an instance-aware proposal-consolidation problem and introduce UniCounting, a foundation-model pipeline with a 3,267-parameter trainable relation head to convert over-complete frozen proposals into complete count vectors with replayable group evidence. • We provide a controlled empirical framework that separates system-level counting performance from proposal-consolidation quality through calibrated complete-vector references, matched-decoder edge comparisons, group-partition diagnostics, and decoder ablations. Using this framework, we show that learned instance relations reduce vector ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error and absent-class false mass relative to the tested edge-score alternatives, while exposing a trade-off between proposal fragmentation and instance merging.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有两方面: 我们把固定的无图像-query的多类计数作为了解实例的建议书整合问题,并引入了UniCounting,即一个具有3 267个参数的可培训关系头的地基模型管道,将超完全被冻结的建议书转换成带有可重复的团体证据的完整的计数载体。 我们提供了一个可控的经验框架,通过校准的完整载体参考、匹配的解码器边缘比较、组分诊断和解码器分解,将系统一级的计数性能与建议整合的质量分开。 使用这个框架,我们显示,与测试过的边缘分数替代物相比,所学实例关系减少了矢量l 1\ell\%1}的误差和缺级的假质量,同时暴露出提案不成体系和实例合并之间的取舍。

blocks.zh: 我们把固定的省略图像-清空多类计数作为体会到建议整合的问题,并引入了UniCounting,即具有3,267个参数可调节关系头的地基模型管道,将超完全被冻结的提议转换成带有可重复的团体证据的完整的计数载体。

Using this framework, we show that learned instance relations reduce vector ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error and absent-class false mass relative to the tested edge-score alternatives, while exposing a trade-off between proposal fragmentation and instance merging.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Few-shot counters identify one target from exemplar boxes ( Ranjan et al. 2021 ; Shi et al. 2022 ; Liu et al. 2022 ; Đukić et al. 2023 ) . Text-conditioned methods instead use a category phrase ( Jiang et al. 2023 ; Amini-Naieni et al. 2023 ; Kang et al. 2024 ; Amini-Naieni et al. 2024 ) . PseCo combines such conditioning with proposals and SAM masks ( Huang et al. 2024 ) . Recent text-guided zero-shot counters further improve cross-modal grounding and exemplar construction ( Qian et al. 2025 ; Liu et al. 2025 ) . In each case, target selection remains external to the counter.
blocks.zh: 很少的射击计数器从实例盒中识别出一个目标(Ranjan等. 2021; Shi等. 2022; 刘等. 页:1 以文字为条件的方法取而代之的是类词(Jiang等. 页:1 2023; 姜等编. 2024; Amini-Naieni等 2024 (英语). PseCo将这种调制与建议书和SAM口罩(Huang等2024年)结合起来. 最近由文字制导的"零射"计数器进一步改善了跨模式地平面和示例构造(Qian等. 2025; 刘等. 2025). 在每种情况下,目标选择仍然在柜台之外。

blocks.en: Supervised multi-class counting predicts one density channel per trained class ( Xu et al. 2021 ; Gao et al. 2024 ) , while SIMCO clusters emergent foreground types ( Godi et al. 2021 ) . These establish fixed-channel and category-discovery precedents, so fixed-vocabulary output alone is not our novelty claim.
blocks.zh: 监督的多级计数预测每个被训练的班级有一个密度通道(徐等2021;高等2024),而SIMCO集群则出现前地类型(高迪等2021). 这些都确立了固定渠道和类别发现的先例,所以单是固定的省产出就不是我们的新说法.

blocks.en: Fixed-category detectors provide class-labeled instances, so summing retained detections by class is a direct complete-vector baseline. Grounding DINO takes category names or referring expressions for open-set detection, and OWLv2 scales detection with language-defined categories ( Liu et al. 2024 ; Minderer et al. 2023 ) . Because this reduction already provides vector outputs, UniCounting focuses on proposal grouping and category admission under vector-level counting errors, with a replayable group for every accepted count.
blocks.zh: 固定类别探测器提供分级标记的例,因此按分级对保留的探测器进行相接是直接的完整载体基线. 地平地DINO取类别名或引用表达式来进行开集检测,而OWLv2天平检测则取自语言自定义的类别(Liu等. 2024; Minder等2023 (中文(简体) ). 由于这种减少已经提供了向量输出,UniCounting专注于在向量级计数错误下的建议分组和分类录入,每个被接受的计数都有一个可重玩的组.

blocks.en: Reference-less counters typically return one anonymous count ( Ranjan and Hoai 2022 ; Hobley and Prisacariu 2023 ; Xu et al. 2023 ) . ABC123 and OCCAM discover multiple image-specific types without exemplars ( Hobley and Prisacariu 2024 ; Spanakis et al. 2026 ) , whereas OmniCount names user-specified categories ( Mondal et al. 2025 ) . PrACo tests whether text-guided counters reject absent labels, while PrACo++ adds negative-label and distractor protocols and MUCCA provides real multi-category scenes ( Ciampi et al. 2025 ; Pacini et al. 2026 ) . UniCounting complements these directions by using one global vocabulary fixed for the entire run before its first image is processed, emitting every coordinate, and reporting both absent-class false mass and presence F1.
blocks.zh: 无参考文献的计数器一般会返回一个匿名的计数器(Ranjan和Hoai 2022;Hobley和Prisacariu 2023;Xu等人 2023). ABC123和OCAM发现多个没有实例的图像特定类型(Hobley和Prisacariu 2024;Spanakis等人 2026),而OmniCount names 用户指定类别(Mondal等人 2025)。 PrACo测试文本制导的计数器是否拒绝缺失的标签,而PrACo++则添加了负标签和分心协议,而MUCCA则提供真实的多类场景(Ciampi等2025;Pacini等2026). UniCounting通过在第一个图像处理之前使用为整个运行所固定的全局词汇来补充这些方向,释放出每一个坐标,并报告缺级的假质量和存在F1.

blocks.en: Foundation models support region discovery and semantic matching ( Kirillov et al. 2023 ; Ravi et al. 2025 ; Radford et al. 2021 ; Cherti et al. 2023 ; Oquab et al. 2024 ) , but their proposal sets contain duplicates and incomplete views. We isolate the conversion of these redundant proposals into a complete named count vector with group-level evidence.
blocks.zh: 基础模型支持区域发现和语义匹配(Kirillov等. 2023; 拉维等. 2025; 拉德福德等. 2021; 切尔蒂等. 2023; Oquab等 2024 ),但其提案集包含重复和不完整的观点. 我们把这些多余的建议 变成一个完整的计数载体 并用组级的证据。

blocks.en: The category head remains fixed, and the relation head is fitted on 210 COCO train2017 images ( Lin et al. 2014 ) , with a disjoint 45-image inner-validation split, denoted inner45, reserved for decoder and threshold selection. A proposal is supervised only when one non-crowd instance accounts for at least 0.8 of its mask, the second-best instance accounts for at most 0.1, and ignore overlap is at most 0.1. Reliable proposal pairs receive same-category and same-instance targets; the completeness target is directional and identifies the proposal with greater ground-truth coverage when the containment and coverage-gap conditions hold. Both directions of each pair are used for training, while Algorithm 1 reads only the same-instance branch at inference. Pair supports, the weighted training objective, and optimization settings are specified in the supplement.

blocks.en: The experiments ask how UniCounting performs under complete-vector counting, whether the relation-head score improves consolidation under a matched decoder, and which partition changes explain its gains and costs. We then analyze the remaining decoder components and their selection trace. All systems are evaluated under the protocol defined in Section 3.1 . OWLv2-All K K satisfies the same complete-vector output requirement, although it receives the fixed K K -class list as an inference input. The Faster R-CNN reference also emits a complete COCO80 vector but uses full COCO box supervision. ABC123 and OCCAM discover anonymous image-specific types, while OmniCount predicts categories requested by a user cue. FSC-147 and CARPK provide only single-coordinate transfer diagnostics under heterogeneous cue protocols, so their results and the full protocol comparison are reported in Supplementary Table S7 rather than used as primary evidence.
blocks.zh: 实验中询问UniCounting如何在全量计数下进行,关系头分数是否在匹配的解码器下改进了合并,以及哪个分区的更改解释了它的增益和成本. 然后我们分析剩下的解码器组件及其选择跟踪. 所有系统都根据第3.1节所定义的协议进行评价。 OWLv2-All K K满足了相同的全向量输出要求,尽管它作为推论输入接收了固定的K-类列表. 更快的R-CNN参考也释放出完整的COCO80向量,但使用完整的COCO盒监督. ABC123和OCCAM发现匿名图像特定类型,而OmniCount预测用户提示请求的类别. FSC-147和CARPK只提供不同提示协议下的单坐标转移诊断,因此其结果和全协议比较在补充表S7中报告,而不是用作主要证据.

blocks.en: 4.3 How does UniCounting perform under complete-vector counting?

blocks.en: Table 1 reports complete-vector performance on COCO clean500. UniCounting is numerically lower than OWLv2-All80 in vector ℓ 1 \ell_{1} (6.485 versus 6.860), present-cell MAE (2.129 versus 2.205), and absent-class false mass (0.325 versus 0.474), while their micro-F1 values are nearly identical (0.416 versus 0.415). We therefore describe the 0.375 vector- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} gap as a point-estimate difference and make no significance claim. The matched-decoder study below separates the contribution of proposal consolidation from the remaining system components.

Its paired vector- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and false-mass intervals against containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO exclude zero. DINO has higher micro-F1, and the overlap guard has lower total-count MAE. Thus, the relation-head score improves the two complete-vector error measures targeted by this comparison, but not every end-task metric.

blocks.en: 4.5 Why does it help, and what does it sacrifice?
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 为什么它有帮助,它牺牲什么?

blocks.en: Figure 3 summarizes the mechanism underlying Table 2 . Mask IoU and containment suppress merges more conservatively but leave substantially more instances fragmented. In contrast, the relation-head score shifts the partition toward aggressive consolidation, obtaining the lowest fragmented rate and complete-vector ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error among the tested edge scores, while accepting a moderate merge-error increase. It also attains a Pair F1 of 0.694, purity of 0.925, and representative IoU of 0.215; formal definitions and the complete partition diagnostics are provided in Supplementary Table S8.

blocks.en: 4.6 Decoder Component Ablation and Selection Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 解码器组件分解和选择分析

blocks.en: Figure 4: Stage-wise effects of the decoder choices selected on inner45 when audited on the frozen clean500 and OmniCount-sub target sets. Panel (a) reports vector- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} improvement, defined as the baseline error minus the selected-variant error; panel (b) reports micro-F1 improvement, defined as the selected-variant score minus the baseline score. Positive values therefore denote improvement in both panels. Baselines are all-edges grouping, maximum-area representation, component-mean labeling, and no admission, respectively. Representative selection and labeling provide the largest consistent gains, whereas the effect of top2-OR sparsification is metric- and dataset-dependent.

Figure 4 separates the contribution of each selected decoder choice on the two frozen target sets. Maximum-category-margin representation and representative raw-cosine labeling consistently improve both vector ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and micro-F1, with labeling producing the largest effect. Background-margin admission provides a smaller additional gain. In contrast, top2-OR sparsification exhibits metric- and dataset-dependent behavior, supporting selection of the complete pipeline on inner45 rather than retrospective target-set tuning. blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The complete-vector evidence is limited to the 500-image COCO evaluation and the project holdout OmniCount-sub, and we do not evaluate MUCCA or PrACo++. clean500 is disjoint from development data and selected without annotations, but remains a subset of COCO val2017, with unknown foundation-model pretraining overlap. The controlled ablation isolates five edge scores and two grouping controls under one decoder. The relation-head score reduces vector error and false mass relative to tested alternatives, but does not minimize total-count MAE; its merge error is higher than mask IoU and containment, while lower than CLIP and DINO. The candidate pool recalls only 62.4% of non-ignore instances at mask IoU 0.50. Since representative selection and admission maximize over 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , changing vocabularies shifts score distributions, and reusing COCO-calibrated thresholds may impair transfer calibration.
blocks.zh: 完全媒介证据仅限于500相COCO评价和项目搁置OmniCount-sub,我们不评价MUCCA或PraACo++. clean500与开发数据脱节,选择时没有说明,但仍是COCO val 2017的一个子集,未知的地基模型预训重叠. 被控制的衰减将五个边缘分数和两个分组控制在一个解码器下隔离. 关系头分数相对于被测试的替代品减少向量错误和虚假质量,但并没有将总计MAE最小化;其合并错误高于口罩IoU和封装,而低于CLIP和DINO. 候选人才库只回顾了口罩IoU 0.50中62.4%的非无酒精病例. 由于代表性选择和录取在 V\ mathcal{V} 上最大化, 变化的词汇值变化分数分配, 以及重新使用COCO 校正阈值, 可能会损害转移校正 。

blocks.en: Trainable capacity is limited to the 3,267-parameter relation head, but inference still runs frozen SAM 2.1, DINOv2, and OpenCLIP components with quadratic pair scoring. Deployment should further address privacy, ontology omissions, and systematic category errors.
blocks.zh: 可训练能力仅限于3,267个参数关系头,但推论仍然运行被冻结的SAM 2.1,DINOv2和带有四相对分的OpenCLIP组件. 部署应进一步处理隐私、本体学遗漏和系统性的类别错误。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
UniCounting studies image-query-free multi-category counting from the perspective of proposal consolidation. Instead of directly mapping redundant segmentation proposals to category counts, it explicitly models proposal identity, forms instance-level components, and produces category-count outputs with traceable group evidence. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head improves proposal partition quality under a controlled decoder comparison, reducing vector-level counting error relative to several similarity-based alternatives.
Our analysis also reveals an inherent trade-off in proposal consolidation: more aggressive grouping reduces fragmentation but may increase instance merging errors. These findings suggest that reliable multi-category counting requires not only semantic recognition but also explicit control over instance identity. Future work should improve proposal recall and develop more adaptive mechanisms for balancing merge and fragmentation errors.
blocks.zh:
UniCounting从提案整合的角度研究无图像-query-无多类计数. 它没有直接绘制分类计数的冗余分解建议图,而是明确模拟建议身份,形成例级组件,并产生分类计数输出出可追踪的群证据. 一个3,267个参数的类别共享关系头在可控解码器比较下改进了建议分区质量,相对于几个基于相似性的替代品,减少了矢量级计数错误.
我们的分析还揭示了合并提案的内在取舍:更积极的分组减少了不成体系,但可能增加合并错误。 这些调查结果表明,可靠的多类别计算不仅需要语义识别,还需要对具体身份的明确控制。 今后的工作应改进提案召回,并发展更适应性的机制,以平衡合并和不成体系的错误。

blocks.en: The training code consumes two fixed COCO train2017 role assignments stored in the source registry: 210 images marked relation_train and 45 images marked inner_validation . It does not generate either role by a random draw, a hash rule, or metric-based filtering. The sets contain 210 and 45 unique identities, respectively, with no overlap. SHA-256 of the numerically sorted, newline-delimited, 12-digit image IDs is 8f5728c98bf1 for train210 and 06744dca51b6 for inner45. Train210 contains 11,341 candidates, 3,262 reliable proposals, and 45,508 reliable unordered pairs; inner45 covers 60 of the 80 COCO categories.
blocks.zh: 训练代码消耗了2个存储在源登记簿中的固定COCO列车2017角色任务:210个图像标记了关系_train,45个图像标记了内-验证. . 它既不通过随机抽取,散列规则产生角色,也不通过基于度量的过滤产生角色. 各套分别有210个和45个独特的身份,没有重叠. 数字排序的SHA-256,新线限定,12位数的图像ID为8f5728c98bf1为列车210型,06744dca51b6为内置45型. 列车210列载有11,341名入选者,3,262个可靠的提议,以及45,508个可靠的无序对;内45列车涵盖80个COCO类别中的60个.

blocks.en: Clean60 is the fixed 60-image COCO val2017 identity list in the released split file (identity SHA-256 f1fcbdcf ). Because its construction does not specify a random-sampling formula, we treat clean60 as a diagnostic set and make no population-level representativeness claim. It is not used for relation-head training, decoder selection, or threshold selection. Its image hashes are disjoint from the 210-image relation-training set and the 45-image inner-validation set, both drawn from train2017, and clean500 is constructed after excluding all clean60 identities. The COCO80 targets contain 340 non-ignore instances from 54 categories and 155 positive image–category cells. Per image, the mean/median non-ignore instance count is 5.667/4 and the mean/median number of present categories is 2.583/2; the largest single-category count is 13, and 96.771% of the 60 × 80 60\times 80 cells are zero.
blocks.zh: Clean60是发布分解文件中固定的60-image COCO val 2017身份列表(身份SHA-256 f1fcbdcf. 由于它的构造没有指定一个随机抽样公式,我们把干净的60作为诊断集,不提出人口层面的代表性主张. 它不用于关系头训练、解码器选择或阈值选择。 它的图像散列与210-图像关系-训练集和45-图像内置-验证集脱节,两者均取自2017年列车,清洁500在排除了所有清洁60个身份后被构建. COCO80目标包含来自54个类别和155个正图像-类别单元格的340个非不光彩实例。 每张图像,中/中非无炎例计数为5.667/4,而目前类别的中/中数为2.583/2;最大的单类计数为13,60×8060\times 80个细胞中96.771%为零.

blocks.en: UniCounting follows the run-level vocabulary protocol of Section 3.1. No per-image category cue is supplied, and FSC-147 target coordinates are extracted only after the full fixed-vocabulary prediction is produced.
blocks.zh: UniCounting遵循了第3.1节的运行级词汇协议. 没有提供每幅图像的分类线索,只有在产生完整的固定站点预测后,才会提取出FSC-147目标坐标.

blocks.zh: FSC-147规定了一个基准目标,但不是场景中每个可计数的类别.

blocks.en: Figure S1: Selected successful complete-vector predictions on COCO clean500. All examples use the primary UniCounting decoder with the fixed seed-17 checkpoint and thresholds selected on inner45. Colored contours indicate the representatives of admitted proposal components, and the accompanying summaries compare all nonzero ground-truth and predicted coordinates. The examples were filtered using fixed correctness and consolidation-complexity criteria and then selected for visual legibility and diversity; they are intended to illustrate successful behaviors rather than estimate average performance. Ground-truth annotations are used only for visualization and evaluation.

blocks.en: The same 24-point grid, zero crop layers, and no-tiling path is applied to every image. Candidates are processed greedily in descending predicted IoU for near-duplicate removal; exact predicted-IoU ties preserve the mask generator’s output order. The formal decoder contains no density, resolution, count-bin, or ground-truth-dependent router.

blocks.en: Clean500 is formed by sorting the 4,940 eligible val2017 file names by SHA256(salt|file_name) , after excluding the clean60 diagnostic identities, and taking the first 500. The salt is exp-v10-coco-val-clean500-v1-20260725 . The selection procedure reads no annotation, prediction, or metric, and clean500 overlaps clean60 in zero images. All thresholds are selected on inner45 and frozen before preprocessing any clean500 or transfer-set image. Ground-truth annotations are loaded only after the prediction files have been finalized.

blocks.en: Unless a table states otherwise, relation-head rows report the mean and sample standard deviation of the three relation-seed point estimates. Clean500 macro-F1 support contains 78 of the 80 COCO categories; toaster and hair drier are excluded because they have no positive ground-truth cells. Each paired confidence interval uses 10,000 image-bootstrap replicates with seed 20260725. Within a replicate, the same resampled image multiplicities are applied to every method and relation seed, each metric is recomputed separately for each seed, and the seed-wise metrics are then averaged. Macro-F1 support is recomputed within every replicate, and categories with zero positives in that replicate are excluded from its macro average. The reported 95% interval is the percentile interval over the seed-averaged replicates.

blocks.en: OWLv2-All80 ( Minderer et al. 2023 ) uses the fixed google/owlv2-base-patch16-ensemble checkpoint at the revision whose SHA begins cfd3195b ; the full hash is provided with the accompanying artifacts. All 80 raw official COCO thing-category names are passed in one identical list for every image, without aliases or a prompt ensemble. Snapshot-native 960 × 960 960\times 960 preprocessing and processor decoding are followed by classwise batched_nms at IoU 0.50. Every detection with score strictly above 0.350 contributes one count. blocks.en: The controlled study fixes the candidate pool and unordered-pair universe together with the top2-OR rule, connected-component construction, maximum-category-margin representative rule, representative raw-cosine labeling rule, and run-matched background-margin admission rule. A single threshold shared across seeds 17, 42, and 73 is selected for each score on the same 45-image inner-validation split.
